tbb-3x05: Echo rejoins the squad, and they haul Nala Se's dead datapad to a snowbound Imperial depot, where a burrowing wyrm forces Hunter and Crosshair to mend their rift.
tbb-3x06: Rex foils a clone assassin's attack on a secret senators' meeting and summons the Batch to his Teth hideout, but a second elite assassin tracks Omega there.
tbb-3x07: Wolffe's commandos and a Clone X killer chase the fugitives through Teth's jungle, until Rex talks his old comrade Wolffe into letting them go.
tbb-3x08: To learn what the M-count means, Hunter and Wrecker team up with Fennec Shand on a bounty hunt, only for her to stall on her promise.
tbb-3x09: Asajj Ventress arrives as Fennec's contact, gauges Omega's Force potential during a sea-monster scrape, downplays what she finds, and warns the clones they aren't safe.
tbb-3x10: Promoted by Hemlock, Emerie Karr enters the Tantiss vault, meets the kidnapped Force-sensitive children held there, and begins to question the work.
tbb-3x11: CX-2 traces Phee's travels to Pabu, and as Imperial troops storm the island, Omega gives herself up to spare its people while Crosshair's tracker shot misses.
tbb-3x12: While Hemlock seals Omega in the Tantiss vault, her brothers hijack the turbo tank carrying Rampart from a prison mine, betting he can lead them to the base.
tbb-3x13: Inside the vault, Omega befriends the captive children and plots an escape, while her brothers and Rampart latch a stolen shuttle onto a Tantiss-bound science vessel.
tbb-3x14: Shot down over Wayland's jungle, the clones push toward Tantiss, while Echo slips inside in stormtrooper armor and finds an unexpected ally in Emerie Karr.
tbb-3x15: Omega and Echo rally Tantiss's prisoners to rescue the captured Batch as Hemlock's project collapses. Years later, a grown Omega leaves Pabu to join the Rebellion.
tote-05: Hunting a Jedi with the Fourth Sister, Barriss Offee watches her partner massacre villagers and strike down a surrendering fugitive, turns on her, and sheds her Inquisitor helmet.
msl-1x01: On Janix, Maul provokes a deadly gang war, then raids the police precinct to seize crime lord Looti Vario and finds a jailed Padawan, Devon Izara.
msl-1x02: Maul escapes Daki and the police with his captives, tempts Devon toward a darker path, and raids a Pyke shipment, as Lawson learns of the Shadow Collective.
msl-1x03: Devon spurns Maul's offer to train her and fights her way out as he stokes her anger, while Vario is forced to bait the Pyke boss.
msl-1x04: Maul kills Pyke boss Marg Krim, ambushes the police when Lawson spurns a truce, and duels Daki and Devon; then an Imperial Star Destroyer arrives.
msl-1x05: The Empire locks down Janix and the Inquisitor Marrok interrogates Lawson, while Daki and Devon, unable to escape the city, turn up at Lawson's home.
msl-1x06: Marrok's raid turns Lawson, his son and the two Jedi into fugitives; when the Inquisitor corners Devon on a train, Maul arrives to fight at her side.
msl-1x07: Devon breaks with Maul as stormtroopers seize Rylee; at a forest waterfall, two Inquisitors kill Scorn and corner Maul, who brings a cave down around them.
msl-1x08: Crippled and alone underground, Maul wrestles with visions of his past, while Two Boots frees Rylee and Rheena Sul wrecks an Imperial ambush meant for them.
msl-1x09: Promised passage by Dryden Vos, Maul teams with Lawson and the Jedi to flee Janix; Spybot and Icarus fall, and Darth Vader waits in the fog.
msl-1x10: Darth Vader kills Daki after Maul abandons him, and Lawson makes a last stand so Rylee can escape. Grieving, Devon agrees to become Maul's apprentice.
fod-2x16: On Ord Mantell, Hondo and IG-88 catch Qi'ra, but she turns her captors against each other and marches both off to collect their bounties.
tote-02: Rebuffed by the Empire and reviled by her Corvus townsfolk, Morgan Elsbeth survives a Noghri assassin's test and wins Thrawn's backing by admitting her true motive, revenge.
owk-01: Obi-Wan lives in hiding on Tatooine, watching young Luke from afar, until Bail Organa begs him to rescue a kidnapped ten-year-old Leia.
owk-02: On Daiyu, Obi-Wan snatches Leia back from her kidnappers while the Inquisitor Reva hunts them, declares Anakin alive, and stabs her own superior.
owk-03: Obi-Wan meets Vader for the first time since Mustafar and is dragged through fire until Tala intervenes, while Reva closes in on Leia.
owk-04: Obi-Wan and Tala infiltrate the Inquisitors' fortress on Nur to free Leia from Reva's interrogation; they escape, unaware that Reva has planted a tracker on them.
owk-05: Vader besieges the refugees on Jabiim and Tala sacrifices herself; Reva, a Temple massacre survivor, strikes at Vader, is left for dead, and learns of Luke.
owk-06: Obi-Wan lures Vader away from the fleeing refugees and defeats him, accepting that Anakin is gone, while Reva finds she cannot kill young Luke on Tatooine.
and-1x01: Searching for his long-lost sister, Cassian kills two corporate security officers outside a Morlana One brothel and slips back to Ferrix to cover his tracks.
and-1x02: As Syril Karn's investigation closes in, Cassian waits on Bix's buyer for a stolen Imperial part, unaware that Bix's jealous partner Timm has tipped off the authorities.
and-1x03: Luthen Rael comes to buy the stolen Starpath unit as Syril's botched raid hits Ferrix, and Cassian escapes with Luthen, who offers him far more than money.
and-1x04: Luthen places Cassian with Vel's rebel cell on Aldhani, which is plotting to steal an Imperial garrison's payroll, as Mon Mothma and Dedra Meero maneuver on Coruscant.
and-1x05: As Vel's crew drills for the Aldhani raid, Cassian's mercenary motives spark mistrust, while Dedra Meero spots a pattern in scattered thefts of Imperial gear.
and-1x06: Under cover of the Eye meteor shower, the crew robs the Aldhani garrison of its payroll at a deadly cost, and Cassian walks away with his share.
and-1x07: The Empire answers Aldhani with harsher sentencing laws, and Cassian, laying low on Niamos, is caught in a pointless arrest and sentenced to six years.
and-1x08: Cassian is shipped to Narkina 5, a prison factory run on electrified floors, as Dedra Meero tightens her grip on Ferrix and Luthen woos Saw Gerrera.
and-1x09: In Narkina 5, Cassian learns no prisoner is ever released and wins Kino Loy toward revolt, while Dedra Meero has Bix tortured to find Cassian's buyer.
and-1x10: Cassian and Kino Loy lead the Narkina 5 prisoners in a breakout, while Luthen tells a mole in the ISB what his crusade has cost him.
and-1x11: Cassian escapes Narkina 5 only to learn Maarva has died; Luthen narrowly evades an Imperial cruiser, and news of the funeral draws a fixated Syril Karn's interest.
and-1x12: Maarva's recorded speech sparks a riot at her funeral; Cassian frees Bix in the chaos, then confronts Luthen with a choice: recruit him or kill him.
reb-s01: Chased by TIE fighters after a convoy raid, Hera and Kanan bicker through Chopper over repairs, until the fed-up droid shoots down the last fighter himself.
reb-s02: Sabine slips onto an Imperial airfield, tags a parked TIE fighter with her signature art, and blows it up as a diversion so the Ghost can escape.
reb-s03: On Lothal, Zeb saves a street vendor from stormtroopers and brawls his way through their reinforcements around a parked TIE fighter, which ends up exploding.
reb-s04: Ezra frees Baron Valen Rudor from his downed TIE fighter, and when the ungrateful pilot scolds him, Ezra strips the ship for parts and takes his helmet.
reb-1x01: Lothal street thief Ezra Bridger crashes the Ghost crew's heist, helps them rescue enslaved Wookiees, and learns that Kanan is a Jedi willing to train him.
reb-1x03: Stealing Imperial weapons for Vizago, the crew runs into C-3PO and R2-D2 and discovers the cargo is banned disruptor rifles, too deadly to hand over.
reb-1x04: Sent to fetch meiloorun fruit, bickering bunkmates Zeb and Ezra draw Imperial attention, hijack a TIE fighter, and learn to work as a team.
reb-1x05: Struggling to train Ezra, Kanan leads a rescue of Jedi Master Luminara Unduli from an Imperial prison, only to find her long dead and the Inquisitor waiting.
reb-1x06: Posing as a cadet at Lothal's Imperial Academy, Ezra steals a decoder with Zare Leonis's help and smuggles out Jai Kell before the Inquisitor can claim him.
reb-1x07: Resentful of Hera's secrets, Sabine is stranded with her at an abandoned asteroid fort, where light-shy fyrnocks attack and the two relearn to trust each other.
reb-1x08: On Empire Day, Ezra's birthday, the crew helps Tseebo, an Imperial defector with a head full of secrets, escape, and Ezra revisits his family's old home.
reb-1x09: Kanan and Ezra lure the Inquisitor to a fyrnock nest so Tseebo can reach Fulcrum, and Ezra, desperate to save his master, draws on the dark side.
reb-1x10: Kanan brings Ezra to a hidden Lothal Jedi Temple, where Ezra confronts his fears, hears Yoda's guidance, and wins the crystal for his own lightsaber.
reb-1x11: After Zeb loses Chopper to Lando Calrissian at sabacc, the crew must help Lando smuggle a puffer pig past Azmorigan and the Empire to reclaim him.
reb-1x12: Trusting a Force vision, Ezra leads the crew to meet dissident Senator Gall Trayvis, who turns out to be an Imperial plant luring them into Kallus's trap.
reb-1x13: Grand Moff Tarkin arrives to crush the Lothal rebels; they seize the Imperial comm tower so Ezra can broadcast a call to resist, but Kanan is captured.
reb-1x14: Defying Hera, Ezra wins Vizago's help with a show of Force power, and Chopper poses as an Imperial courier droid to learn Kanan is bound for Mustafar.
reb-1x15: The crew storms Tarkin's Star Destroyer over Mustafar to rescue Kanan, who defeats the Inquisitor; a rebel fleet arrives, and Fulcrum is revealed as Ahsoka Tano.
and-2x01: A year on, Cassian steals a prototype TIE fighter and lands among feuding rebels, while Krennic secretly briefs the ISB on a plan for Ghorman.
and-2x02: Trapped in a rebel feud, Cassian escapes in his stolen TIE, as Dedra reluctantly takes on Ghorman and an Imperial officer's attentions put Bix in danger.
and-2x03: On Mina-Rau, Bix kills an Imperial officer who assaults her; Cassian arrives to fly the exiles out, but Brasso is killed, as Mon Mothma's daughter weds.
reb-2x01: Lured back to Lothal to extract a defecting minister, the crew barely survives Darth Vader, who frames them for her death and discovers Ahsoka is alive.
reb-2x03: Sent by Ahsoka to find an old friend, the crew meets Rex and fellow clone veterans Wolffe and Gregor on Seelos, reopening Kanan's wounds from Order 66.
reb-2x04: Wolffe's suspicions bring Agent Kallus to Seelos, where rebels and old clones fight his walkers side by side, and Rex rejoins Ahsoka.
reb-2x05: Raiding a derelict Republic medical station for supplies, Ezra, Zeb, Sabine and Chopper run into two new Inquisitors, the Fifth Brother and the Seventh Sister.
reb-2x06: Ducking chores, Ezra answers a distress call from the pirate Hondo Ohnaka, gets swept into his schemes, and realizes he no longer wants to go it alone.
reb-2x07: Hera seeks out reclusive engineer Quarrie and flies his untested B-wing prototype through an Imperial blockade to save starving Ibaar, earning the title Phoenix Leader.
reb-2x08: Picking up a secret courier droid, Sabine runs into Ketsu Onyo, her old partner turned bounty hunter, and the estranged friends end up fighting side by side.
reb-2x09: When an Interdictor's gravity well snares Ezra and Commander Sato, Kanan and Rex bury their mistrust, sneak aboard, and turn the ship's weapon against it.
fod-1x07: On Garel, Jyn Erso snatches back a girl's pet tooka from bullying stormtroopers, outwits them in the back alleys, and returns the cat to its owner.
reb-2x10: Ahsoka and the crew rescue Force-sensitive infants from the Fifth Brother and Seventh Sister, but a probe droid learns the rebels are hiding on Garel.
and-2x04: Cassian and a traumatized Bix hide in Luthen's Coruscant safehouse, while Syril goes undercover among Ghorman's dissidents for the ISB and Wilmon falls in with Saw Gerrera.
and-2x05: Posing as a fashion designer, Cassian sizes up the Ghorman Front's heist plans, while Kleya's listening bug risks exposure and Wilmon is initiated into Saw's Partisans.
and-2x06: Cinta is killed by a stray shot during a Ghorman heist the ISB is watching, while Bix, with Cassian's help, takes revenge on her torturer.
reb-2x11: A vision of his parents draws Ezra back to Lothal, where ex-governor Ryder Azadi reveals they died in a prison breakout sparked by Ezra's own broadcast.
reb-2x12: Princess Leia brings three cruisers to Lothal for the rebels to steal, sparing Alderaan suspicion, and improvises with Ezra and Kanan when Imperial security tightens.
reb-2x13: After Mandalorian Protectors ambush Hera's squadron and injure her, Kanan and Sabine confront their leader, Fenn Rau, and capture him to secure safe passage.
reb-2x14: Rescued from the Empire, two Lasat survivors convince a doubting Zeb he's their prophesied guide, and he leads them through a stellar maelstrom to their lost homeworld.
reb-2x15: Running on empty, the crew raids a Mining Guild refinery, where Ezra bonds with the vast space whales called purrgil, who help turn the fight.
fod-1x08: Sabine stages Princess Leia's kidnapping to collect secret Imperial base locations, and the two turn Leia's stormtrooper guards against the bounty droid IG-88 to get away.
reb-2x16: Hera joins her estranged father, Twi'lek freedom fighter Cham Syndulla, to steal an Imperial carrier over Ryloth; his hunger for vengeance nearly derails the job.
reb-2x17: Marooned on a frozen moon of Geonosis, Zeb and his old enemy Kallus must work together to survive, and the Lasat's mercy leaves Kallus shaken.
reb-2x18: At Lothal's Jedi Temple, Kanan is knighted after facing a spectral Temple Guard, Ezra is pointed to Malachor by Yoda, and Ahsoka learns what became of Anakin.
reb-2x19: Marooned aboard an Imperial transport after stealing a new leg, Chopper befriends fussy inventory droid AP-5, who defects and points the rebels to a new base.
reb-2x20: Setting up a new base on remote Atollon, the rebels discover giant krykna spiders nearby, while Hera dreads Kanan and Ezra's coming journey to Malachor.
fod-2x15: Ahsoka tosses away the crystal from Ezra's new lightsaber and presses him with her blade, teaching him to trust the Force rather than his weapon.
fod-1x09: Raiding an Imperial warehouse for food, Sabine and Ketsu find a Chadra-Fan boy in a crate, and saving him wins Ketsu over to the rebels.
fod-1x16: Sabine reluctantly lends her freshly painted speeder bike to reckless Ketsu for a courier run, and when only a handlebar returns, she forgives her friend.
reb-2x21: On Malachor, Ezra, Kanan and Ahsoka meet Maul, who betrays them and blinds Kanan, while Ahsoka faces her former master, Vader, as the Sith temple collapses.
fod-2x01: Rushing a medkit heist, Sabine and Hera take off in the wrong shuttle, full of stormtroopers, and must leap mid-flight to the one Chopper is flying.
fod-1x13: Jyn Erso picks up a holo-map Sabine dropped and gets chased as the thief; Sabine saves her and talks the loner into handing it over.
reb-3x01: Emboldened by the Sith holocron, Ezra leads a reckless Y-wing heist, while the blinded Kanan seeks out the Bendu and returns in time to save him.
reb-3x03: Maul holds the Ghost crew hostage so Ezra will merge the Jedi and Sith holocrons with him; they glimpse twin suns before Kanan pulls Ezra away.
reb-3x04: Undercover at an Imperial flight academy, Sabine helps star cadets Wedge Antilles and Hobbie defect to the rebellion, springing free of a trap on the way.
reb-3x05: Hera sneaks into her family's occupied Ryloth home to reclaim her mother's kalikori; she and Ezra are captured and escape, but Thrawn keeps the heirloom.
reb-3x06: At an abandoned Clone Wars base, Rex and the rebels meet Separatist droids still at war, replay the old fight, and then join forces against the Empire.
reb-3x07: Checking on silent Concord Dawn, Sabine, Ezra and captive Fenn Rau find his Protectors slaughtered by Gar Saxon's Imperial Super Commandos, and Rau joins the rebellion.
reb-3x08: On Mykapo, the crew meets Iron Squadron, three teen rebels led by Sato's nephew Mart Mattin, and must rescue Mart when an Imperial trap closes.
reb-3x09: Hondo enlists the crew to loot proton bombs from an Imperial freighter sinking into Wynkahthu's atmosphere, where sentry droids and Hondo's greed nearly doom the job.
reb-3x10: Slipping into Lothal's Imperial factory in disguise, Kanan and Ezra steal plans as Thrawn exposes a saboteur, and learn the rebel informant Fulcrum is Agent Kallus.
reb-3x11: To break Maul's hold on his mind, Ezra, Kanan and Sabine join Maul on Dathomir; there Maul learns Kenobi is alive, and Sabine takes the Darksaber.
reb-3x12: Sent after Saw Gerrera's vanished squad, the crew finds Geonosis emptied by the Empire, save one Geonosian guarding an egg, and clashes with Saw's ruthless methods.
reb-3x14: A stray droid Zeb brings home is an armed Imperial infiltrator; the rebels send it back to destroy its fellow spies, but Thrawn still narrows his search.
reb-3x15: Kanan trains Sabine with the Darksaber so she can unite Mandalore, forcing her to confront the weapon she once built for the Empire and her estranged family.
reb-3x16: Sabine brings the Darksaber home to Krownest, where her mother betrays her to Gar Saxon; Sabine defeats him, and Clan Wren turns on the Empire.
fod-2x11: When stormtroopers build an outpost onto the old statue of their forebear Tarre Vizsla, Sabine persuades her brother Tristan to help her tear it down.
and-2x07: With the rebel base on Yavin growing, Cassian defies orders and slips off with Wilmon to Ghorman, as Imperial troops mass there, to assassinate Dedra Meero.
and-2x08: An Imperial false-flag shot turns Ghorman's protest into a massacre; Syril, stumbling on Cassian aiming at Dedra, attacks him and is killed by a Ghorman rebel.
reb-3x17: Ezra sneaks aboard Thrawn's flagship to extract Kallus, but the spy chooses to stay, framing another officer, unaware Thrawn has already unmasked him.
and-2x09: Mon Mothma denounces the Ghorman massacre on the Senate floor and escapes Coruscant with Cassian's help; afterward, Bix leaves him, and a reprogrammed K-2SO powers up.
reb-3x18: The Ghost crew and Gold Squadron sneak fugitive Senator Mon Mothma past Thrawn's fleet, and her broadcast unites scattered rebel cells into one Alliance.
reb-3x19: Stealing Imperial clearance codes with Wedge and AP-5, Chopper is hacked by an Imperial controller and hijacks the Ghost, locking the crew in the cargo bay.
reb-3x20: Ezra slips off to Tatooine to find Obi-Wan Kenobi and unwittingly leads Maul there; in a swift final duel, Kenobi strikes Maul down.
reb-3x21: Thrawn unmasks Kallus and besieges Chopper Base; Commander Sato gives his life to break the blockade, and Mandalorian allies and the Bendu's fury help the rebels escape.
reb-4x01: Sabine rescues her imprisoned father, destroys the Duchess, the armor-targeting superweapon she once designed, and passes the Darksaber to Bo-Katan.
reb-4x03: Ezra and Sabine join Saw Gerrera on an Imperial freighter hauling a giant kyber crystal; when Saw turns reckless, they destroy it and free the prisoners aboard.
reb-4x05: Back on Lothal at Ryder Azadi's call, Ezra and the crew find a planet crushed under Imperial occupation and learn of Thrawn's deadly new TIE Defender.
reb-4x06: Ezra and Sabine steal a prototype TIE Defender Elite and crash it on Lothal, and a Loth-wolf carries them to safety, leaving Ezra a cryptic word.
reb-4x07: Hunted by Thrawn's assassin Rukh, the rebels get Hera off Lothal with the Defender's flight data, while Loth-wolves lead the others through hidden passages to safety.
reb-4x08: To get a message to Hera past Imperial jamming, the Lothal rebels commandeer a giant ore crawler, freeing its enslaved workers, among them an old acquaintance, Vizago.
reb-4x09: Hera's rebel strike punches through Thrawn's blockade over Lothal, but a second wave of TIEs overwhelms her squadron, and Hera crash-lands and is captured.
reb-4x10: Kanan leads a glider raid to rescue Hera from Governor Pryce, then holds back a fuel depot's inferno so his friends can escape, sacrificing himself.
reb-4x11: As the crew mourns Kanan, Sabine and Zeb find his sacrifice crippled the TIE Defender factory, and the Loth-wolf Dume steers Ezra toward the Jedi Temple.
reb-4x12: Loth-wolves carry Ezra and Sabine to the Jedi Temple, where Imperials are digging; Sabine decodes an ancient mural, and Ezra leaps through a hidden portal.
reb-4x13: In a realm beyond time, Ezra snatches Ahsoka from her duel with Vader and must resist rescuing Kanan as the Emperor tries to seize the gateway.
reb-4x14: Ryder feigns betrayal to lure Governor Pryce into attacking the Lothal rebels' camp, and when Hera arrives with old allies, the tables turn and Pryce is captured.
reb-4x15: Lothal is freed as Ezra spurns the Emperor and sends purrgil to drag Thrawn's flagship, and himself, into hyperspace; Sabine and Ahsoka later go after him.
tote-06: Barriss, now a healer, helps a Force-sensitive child escape the Fourth Sister, who accidentally stabs her, then renounces the Inquisitors and carries her to safety.
fod-2x04: On Ord Mantell, a Chadra-Fan pickpocket grabs Jyn's kyber pendant; she chases him across the rooftops, recovers it, and, seeing he's starving, hands him her fruit.
and-2x10: Dedra Meero corners Luthen, who stabs himself rather than talk; Kleya slips into the hospital to end his life, while the ISB arrests Dedra.
and-2x11: With Luthen dead and Dedra jailed, the ISB hunts Kleya and her terrible secret, and Cassian defies orders to extract her from Coruscant before the net closes.
and-2x12: K-2SO rescues Cassian and Kleya from the ISB; on Yavin, Luthen's final intel on an Imperial superweapon stuns the rebels, and Cassian is sent to Kafrene.
fod-1x05: Hunting for Chewbacca in Echo Base's tunnels, Leia finds him held by a wampa and lures it away while he and R2-D2 wall the beast in.
fod-2x07: On Dagobah, Yoda rides in Luke's backpack as he races through the treetops, teaching him to rely on the Force instead of his eyes.
fod-2x06: To rescue Han, Leia and Chewbacca seek out Maz Kanata on Ord Mantell, and a brawl with bounty hunter Boushh hands Leia the perfect disguise.
fod-1x03: Leia follows Wicket to two Ewoks held by stormtroopers and helps him spring a rope trap to free them; the grateful Ewoks reward her with a village dress.
fod-1x14: After Endor, Leia stops the Ewoks from cooking captured stormtroopers and sends Han to Hera for rations, which cost him admitting the Ghost beats the Falcon.
fod-2x14: Luke and Leia help Wicket and Kneesaa fend off a giant Gorax; Luke plays decoy while Leia borrows his lightsaber to spring the Ewoks' log trap.
fod-2x09: Scrambling to stop stray TIE fighters heading for the Ewok village, Hera finds Chopper has brought two Ewoks along as gunners, and they prove crack shots.
man-1x01: Hired by a shadowy Imperial client, the Mandalorian hunts his quarry to a remote camp, finds the infant Grogu, and shoots IG-11 to save him.
man-1x02: Jawas strip the Razor Crest, and the Mandalorian must win the parts back with a mudhorn's egg, surviving the beast only because Grogu uses the Force.
man-1x03: The Mandalorian trades Grogu to the Client for beskar, then relents, storms the compound to take him back, and escapes the Guild's hunters with his tribe's help.
man-1x04: On Sorgan, the Mandalorian and Cara Dune train villagers to beat raiders and their AT-ST, but a hunter's arrival dashes his plan to leave Grogu there.
man-1x05: On Tatooine, the Mandalorian helps rookie hunter Toro Calican bring in assassin Fennec Shand, but Toro guns her down and turns on him, seizing Grogu.
man-1x06: Joining Ran's crew to spring a prisoner from a New Republic transport, the Mandalorian is double-crossed, turns the tables, and leaves them locked in the brig.
man-1x07: Promised peace by Greef Karga, the Mandalorian returns to Nevarro to take down the Client, but Moff Gideon's troops strike first, killing Kuiil and seizing Grogu.
man-1x08: IG-11 rescues Grogu and escorts the heroes to safety before sacrificing himself; Din Djarin downs Moff Gideon's fighter and vows to return Grogu to his kind.
man-2x01: Seeking other Mandalorians on Tatooine, Din finds Cobb Vanth wearing Boba Fett's armor and wins it by uniting townsfolk and Tuskens against a krayt dragon.
man-2x02: For a lead on other Mandalorians, Din ferries the Frog Lady and her eggs, but a crash on an ice world stirs a nest of giant spiders.
tote-03: A New Republic envoy returns to Corvus offering Morgan Elsbeth a fair trial if she yields power; Elsbeth massacres the delegation and tightens her grip on Calodan.
man-2x03: On Trask, Din meets Bo-Katan, whose Mandalorians challenge his creed, and helps them raid an Imperial freighter in return for a lead on Ahsoka Tano.
man-2x04: On Nevarro, Din helps Cara and Greef blow up an Imperial base, uncovering Gideon's plans for Grogu's blood, while a spy plants a tracker on his ship.
man-2x05: On Corvus, Din finds Ahsoka Tano besieging Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth; Ahsoka learns the child's name, Grogu, but declines to train him and sends Din to Tython.
man-2x06: On Tython, Boba Fett arrives to reclaim his armor and joins Din against stormtroopers, but Gideon's Dark Troopers snatch Grogu and the Razor Crest is destroyed.
man-2x07: To locate Gideon, Din recruits ex-Imperial Migs Mayfeld for a raid on Morak, where Din unmasks to use an Imperial terminal and Mayfeld avenges a massacre.
man-2x08: Din's team storms Gideon's cruiser and Din wins the Darksaber, but Luke Skywalker saves them from the Dark Troopers, and Grogu leaves to train with him.
bobf-01: Now ruling Jabba's territory, Boba Fett survives an assassination attempt in Mos Espa, while bacta-tank dreams recall his escape from the Sarlacc and captivity among Tuskens.
bobf-02: Boba traces the assassins to Mos Espa's mayor and rebuffs the Hutt Twins, while flashbacks show him earning a Tusken tribe's trust by stopping a spice train.
bobf-03: Boba recruits a gang of modded youths, fends off Black Krrsantan, and learns the Pykes are behind his troubles; in flashback, his Tusken tribe is massacred.
bobf-04: Flashbacks show Boba saving a dying Fennec Shand and reclaiming his ship; now, he hires Krrsantan and asks Mos Espa's crime families to stand against the Pykes.
bobf-05: Din Djarin is cast out of his covert for having unmasked, and on Tatooine he test-flies a rebuilt Naboo starfighter before agreeing to fight for Boba.
bobf-06: While Luke trains Grogu and offers him a choice between Yoda's lightsaber and Din's beskar gift, Cad Bane guns down Cobb Vanth for the Pykes.
bobf-07: In the battle for Mos Espa, Grogu rejoins Din, Boba rides his rancor against the Pykes' droids and kills Cad Bane, and Fennec eliminates the syndicate's bosses.
man-3x01: To atone for unmasking, Din plans to bathe in Mandalore's Living Waters, fails to revive IG-11 as his guide, and seeks out a despondent Bo-Katan.
